title: A reporter can never send us a log: the Report on GitHub button is dead in every release
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-672 - Issue #2: a silent curated-deps failure ships a broken engine and the log can never reach us (2026-09-01). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-672/plan.md. /github/create-issue needs GITHUB_TOKEN from .env, which the portable build excludes, so the route 500s and the client swallows it. /logs/download has no UI caller and the issue template names no log path. This is why issue #2 arrived with an empty log tail.
